manim_fontawesome¶

Utilities for the package module.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.brand = <manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.Brand object>¶

Enum of brand-style icon names mapped to their SVG paths.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.regular = <manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.Regular object>¶

Enum of regular-style icon names mapped to their SVG paths.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.solid = <manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.Solid object>¶

Enum of solid-style icon names mapped to their SVG paths.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.FONT_AWESOME_VERSION = '6.5.1'¶

Font Awesome release bundled with the package.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome.list_icons(style='solid')[source]¶

Return the names of every bundled icon for style.

Parameters:

style (str) – One of "solid", "regular", or "brand".

Return type:

list[str]

Returns:

Icon names in definition order; use getattr(solid, name) (or the matching namespace) to obtain the icon mobject.

manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome._get_svg_object(fp)[source]¶

Load an SVG file as a white mobject.

Parameters:

fp (str) – Filesystem path of the SVG file.

Return type:

SVGMobject

Returns:

The icon as a white SVG mobject.

Usage¶

Get a Font Awesome icon as an SVGMobject.

Example: IconScene ¶

from manim import *
from manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome import solid

class IconScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        rocket = solid.rocket.set_color(ORANGE)
        self.add(rocket)

from manim import *
from manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome import BrandEnum

BrandEnumTarget = BrandEnum

class BrandEnumOverview(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        public = [n for n in dir(BrandEnumTarget) if not n.startswith("_")]
        card = VGroup(
            Text('BrandEnum', font_size=36),
            Text('module: manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome', font_size=18, color=GREY),
            Text('Bundled brand-style icon paths', font_size=22),
            Text("API: " + ", ".join(public[:6]), font_size=18, color=BLUE),
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.25)
        card.scale_to_fit_width(11.5).move_to(ORIGIN)
        frame = RoundedRectangle(
            width=12.1, height=card.height + 0.5, corner_radius=0.2, color=BLUE_D
        ).move_to(card)
        self.add(frame, card)

Examples

Example: SolidEnumOverview ¶

from manim import *
from manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome import SolidEnum

SolidEnumTarget = SolidEnum

class SolidEnumOverview(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        public = [n for n in dir(SolidEnumTarget) if not n.startswith("_")]
        card = VGroup(
            Text('SolidEnum', font_size=36),
            Text('module: manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome', font_size=18, color=GREY),
            Text('Bundled solid-style icon paths', font_size=22),
            Text("API: " + ", ".join(public[:6]), font_size=18, color=BLUE),
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.25)
        card.scale_to_fit_width(11.5).move_to(ORIGIN)
        frame = RoundedRectangle(
            width=12.1, height=card.height + 0.5, corner_radius=0.2, color=BLUE_D
        ).move_to(card)
        self.add(frame, card)

from manim_extensions.fontawesome.manim_fontawesome import SolidEnum

icon_path = SolidEnum.star.value
